claims.text: Google is moving Local Services Ads into Google Ads as Performance Max pay-per-lead campaigns
Phased rollout targets home and storefront service advertisers including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, cleaning, and pest control
Historical LSA performance data must be exported before migration since it does not carry over automatically
Performance Max bidding is guided by the lead-outcome data reported back, making accurate CRM tracking more important for ad efficiency
The platform tracks every lead through to the revenue it produces
The Ad ROI Calculator is a free tool published at blackarrow.ltd/tools
It calculates cost per lead, cost per booked job, and revenue per dollar of ad spend from monthly spend, lead count, close rate, and job value inputs
No signup is required to use it
